title: ICE officer fatally shoots woman in south Minneapolis, investigation underway
summary: An ICE officer fatally shot a woman Wednesday morning in south Minneapolis, according to Tricia McLaughlin, the Department of Homeland Security's assistant secretary for public affairs.
contentText: An ICE officer fatally shot a woman Wednesday morning in south Minneapolis, according to the Department of Homeland Security. The victim was a 37-year-old U.S. citizen. City leaders said the victim was a legal observer of federal actions in the city.
